description: Find broken links on a website's home page: lists the page's links and checks a sample of them live, reporting each one's status, plus target=_blank links missing rel=noopener. No KinetixSEO account needed. A site checked in the last 24 hours gets that stored result. Free: spends no credits.

url.description: The website to check: a domain (example.com) or any URL on it. The home page of that domain is checked.

name: check_broken_links
title: Check broken links
